blocks.text: Thank you for sending the reserve detail through last week. David Sherman has it and has already begun reconciling it against the year-end figures you carry, which is exactly the order we hoped to work in. So far it ties out well, with a single grouping question at the summary level that he is still running to ground; it looks like a rounding or aggregation difference and not anything of substance, and we will let you know the moment it is closed.

The one thing that would move us forward now is the assumption documentation for the {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}} valuation as it stood at the valuation date, since that is what lets us finish the first cut of the exhibits. If the interest and mortality bases live with someone other than you, a pointer is plenty and I will follow up with them directly. Anything that touches how the review is scoped, or which of the board's questions we take on, we are keeping with Jennifer Vasquez, so you hear one considered answer on those rather than three partial ones.

For our own file I have logged everything received so far under your name, Michelle Hudson, so that our reliance on each file is documented as we go. If you can send whatever of the assumption set is ready this week, I will confirm each piece the same day it lands, and that is really all we need from your side for now.
